captions.detailed: A floor-standing task lamp featuring a heavy, flat cylindrical base, a vertical support rod, and two thin articulated arm links connected by mechanical hinges. The upper arm terminates in a pivoting conical shade that houses the bulb. The base and structural arms are finished in a matte black, while the conical lamp head is made of a contrasting grey/silver metal.
captions.instruction: Generate a floor-standing task lamp with a heavy round base, two articulated arm links, and a conical metal shade. The lower arm should rotate on a hinge above the vertical base post, the upper arm on an elbow hinge, and the shade should tilt on a hinge at the tip bracket.
captions.factory: The code constructs a multi-part assembly. It starts with a base link consisting of a wide, flat cylinder and a vertical rod. The first arm is modeled as a cylinder connected to the base via a revolute joint. The second arm is similarly modeled as a cylinder and joined to the first arm with an elbow joint. Finally, the lamp head is constructed using a hollowed-out cone (or lofted circles) and connected to the second arm via a tilting revolute joint at the tip bracket.
